hostname x1
interface Loopback0
 ipv4 address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.255
!
interface TenGigE0/0/0/0
 description n1
 ipv4 address 198.51.100.2 255.255.255.252
!
interface TenGigE0/0/0/1
 description x2
 ipv4 address 198.51.100.5 255.255.255.252
!
interface TenGigE0/0/0/2
 description x3
 ipv4 address 198.51.100.9 255.255.255.252
!
route-policy PASS
  pass
end-policy
!
router ospf CORE
 router-id 192.0.2.1
 area 0
  interface Loopback0
   cost 1
   passive enable
  !
  interface TenGigE0/0/0/1
   cost 10
   network point-to-point
  !
  interface TenGigE0/0/0/2
   cost 10
   network point-to-point
  !
 !
!
prefix-set ANYCAST
  203.0.113.128/26
end-set
!
route-policy FROM-N1
  if destination in ANYCAST then
    set local-preference 200
  endif
  pass
end-policy
!
router bgp 64502
 bgp router-id 192.0.2.1
 address-family ipv4 unicast
 !
 neighbor 198.51.100.1
  remote-as 64501
  description n1
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-policy FROM-N1 in
   route-policy PASS out
  !
 !
 neighbor 192.0.2.2
  remote-as 64502
  description x2
  update-source Loopback0
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-reflector-client
   next-hop-self
  !
 !
 neighbor 192.0.2.3
  remote-as 64502
  description x3
  update-source Loopback0
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   route-reflector-client
   next-hop-self
  !
 !
!
end
